stemMd: Which formula correctly represents aluminium sulfate?
explanationMd: Aluminium is Al³⁺ and sulfate is SO₄²⁻. The least common charge magnitude is six: two aluminium ions give +6 and three sulfate ions give −6. Write the intact polyatomic sulfate group in parentheses.

distractorRationale.a: A +3 aluminium ion and a −2 sulfate ion do not balance one-to-one.
distractorRationale.c: This gives total charges +9 and −4 rather than neutrality.
distractorRationale.d: Two aluminium ions require more than one sulfate ion.
distractorRationale.e: One aluminium ion cannot balance three sulfate ions.
